mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns; a low federal funds rate (as measured by the current value) is associated with positive 20-day forward returns, and this relationship is always active without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (the 5-year median), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals a high-inflation regime that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are above their 1-year moving averages, the strong demand environment signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST and RSAFS both above 1-year MA), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is below its 1-year moving average, indicating a supply contraction, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 1-year MA), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a weak labor market that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of the non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns; a high level of employment (as measured by the current value) is associated with positive 60-day forward returns, and this relationship is always active without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS is above the 5-year median, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low and the unemployment rate is low, the combined effect signals a strong economy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and UNRATE < 3.5% (the 5-year median thresholds), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is above its 1-year moving average, indicating a strong demand expansion, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (GDPC1 > 1-year MA), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
